summary.en: Ukraine is intensifying precision drone strikes on Russian oil refineries while Russia is conducting glide‑bomb attacks that have killed at least 20 people in Zaporizhzhia and a drone strike that killed an 11‑year‑old boy and injured five in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast. Russia has shut down two Yandex data centres in Vladimir and a third site after reported drone attacks. Trump publicly urges Ukraine to replace President Zelenskyy, linking the disputed diesel deal with calls for new leadership. Zelenskyy says Ukraine will cease refinery strikes if Russia halts its energy attacks. The conflict caused 75,767 battle‑related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Ukraina intensiverer presisjons‑droneangrep mot russiske oljeraffinerier mens Russland gjennomfører glidebombeangrep som har drept minst 20 personer i Zaporizjzja og et droneangrep som drepte en 11‑årig gutt og såret fem i Dnipropetrovsk oblast. Russland har stengt to Yandex‑datacentere i Vladimir og et tredje anlegg etter rapporterte droneangrep. Trump oppfordrer offentlig Ukraina til å erstatte president Zelenskyj, og knytter den omstridte dieselforhandlingen til krav om nytt lederskap. Zelenskyj sier at Ukraina vil stoppe raffineriangrepene dersom Russland stanser sine energiangrep. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)
background.extract: On 24 February 2022, Russia invaded Ukraine, starting the largest and deadliest war in Europe since World War II, in a major escalation of the existing war between the two countries that began when Russia attacked Ukraine in 2014. The fighting has caused hundreds of thousands of military casualties and tens of thousands of Ukrainian civilian casualties. Russian troops occupy roughly 20% of Ukraine. From a population of 41 million, about 8 million Ukrainians have been internally displaced and 6–7 million have fled the country, creating Europe's largest refugee crisis since World War II.
